data.release_policy: A complete-case release requires nonnull bill_len,bill_dep,flipper_len,body_mass ANDsex. Zero is not missing. Compare released species proportions with the full344-record archive;report signed percentage-point change. This is a composition audit,not a test that missingness is random.
data.units: bill/flipper mm;body_mass grams;species/island/sex/year remain categorical metadata.
